verdict.rationale: Poly is an AI-powered file storage product, so whether user data is used for model training is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack has no documentation of a training opt-out, a no-training guarantee, or any data-usage policy. The editable Mind memories (poly-docs-57) and share revocation are adjacent features and do not address model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
